Name: Forest Junimos
Author: KeDili
Description:
[b][size=3] ﻿Features:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Junimos added to forest maps which dance, meep, wave hand and talk to you! Includes interactions for SVE, DTZ and RSV[/size]
[*][size=3]A junimo statue you can add into your farm which summons junimos! (Can be built via Wizard's book)[/size]
[*][size=3]Community Center will have junimos if you go the CC route (Maybe even a prismatic one?)[/size]
[/list][size=3][b] ﻿﻿Things to know[/b]
- To be able to see junimos, you need to have met the Wizard. If they're still not there they should appear the next day after you met him.
- I wont do anything for mobile compatibility unless Android SMAPI succeeds to run the frameworks properly.

[b] Installation[/b]
- Install latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI [/url]
- Install latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 
- Install latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]
[/url]- Install latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url]
- Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[b] ﻿Config Options[/b]
[b]- ﻿[/b][b]﻿"RecolorPalettes": [/b]When set to true, junimos will have matching colors with your recolor mod if its supported. Currently supports Starblue Valley, DaisyNiko’s Earthy Recolor, Rosier Colored Glasses, and A Wittily Named Recolor with authors’ permissions.

[/size][size=1](Except Starblue Valley, since the author already has written down that usage of files is allowed to provide mod compatibility if you link back.).
[/size]
[size=3][b] ﻿Have these recolors' links![/b]
- Earthy: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255[/url]
- Starblue: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869[/url]
- Rosier: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8372]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8372[/url]
- Wittily: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995[/url][/size]

[size=3][b]- “AllowSpritesheetChanges”:[/b] When set to true, junimos will use vanilla sprites and change if any mod edits the vanilla Junimo spritesheet.[/size]

[size=3] [/size][b][size=3] If You Encounter A Bug[/size][/b]
[size=3]- Please upload your log to [/size][url=https://smapi.io/log][size=3]https://smapi.io/log[/size][/url][size=3] and see the instructions there, then submit a bug report to this page and attach your log (and a picture, if it’s something visual). I cannot help you without a log!!
